# Tanker Shipping

## Bi-Weekly Industry Report

### June 30, 2026

- **VLCC Spot Drops from Crisis Highs, but Volatility Remains -** The Very Large Crude Carrier (VLCC) Arabian Gulf (AG) market experienced extreme volatility during the past week, with spot rates fluctuating sharply due to dynamic geopolitical risks in the Strait of Hormuz. While shipowners continually evaluate risk-versus- reward profiles for regional transits, sentiment is supported by a tangible recovery in Middle Eastern supply, driven by Saudi Arabia resuming loadings at Ras Tanura alongside expanded export programs from ADNOC, Qatar, Iraq, Kuwait, and Iran.
